# narrates

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:narrates`](gmeow-narrates.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/narrates>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)

Flat 80% seam link: the segment shows, narrates, or mentions the diegetic entity, event, or situation. Range intentionally open (entities, events, situations, motifs). NOT functional: a chapter narrates many things. Promote to a [`gmeow:NarrationUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NarrationUsage.md) relator ONLY when mode, vantage, or confidence rides on the link (the efficiency doctrine — flat is the default at corpus scale).
